description: The status for rate limited requests, ideally with `Retry-After` telling the client when to try again.
Count requests per key in calendar-aligned windows. Simple and cheap, but allows a double burst around each boundary.
Weights the previous window's count by how much of it overlaps the last `windowMs`, removing most of the boundary burst.
A bucket of `capacity` tokens refilled at a steady rate; each request takes one. Allows short bursts and a sustained average rate.
What is being limited: IP, user id, API key, route, or a combination. The wrong key either blocks shared networks or lets attackers rotate identities.
Counters in a shared store (Redis `INCR` with expiry, or a Lua script) so every instance enforces the same limit.
